confidence_rationale: A balanced review establishing that replay content is NOT a faithful re-run of dominant prior experience: it is biased toward reward, can run forward to guide future behaviour, and includes non-experienced / recombined sequences. This undercuts the premise that replay must reinforce already-dominant trajectory classes, and supports Q-055 counter-mechanism (b) that replay may be designed to sample/recombine rather than concentrate. Confidence 0.55 because it is a conceptual review (not a quantitative diversity measurement) and the same flexibility could in principle be neutral for diversity.
failure_signatures: Replay is not a veridical replay of the most-traversed path: it over-represents rewarded locations and can generate forward, recombined, or never-experienced sequences -- so a simple 'replay strengthens the dominant trace' erosion model is too crude.
Because replay can be generative/recombinative, sleep could in principle INCREASE trajectory-class diversity, the opposite of the winner-take-all worry.

mapping.source_claim_statement: The content of hippocampal replay correlates only partly with prior behaviour: replay over-represents rewarded experience, can be prospective (guiding future behaviour), and can reflect recombined or pre-existing network assemblies rather than faithful past trajectories.
mapping.ree_translation: Bears on whether Q-055's erosion premise even holds. If REE's sleep replay (SD-017) inherits this generative/recombinative character, replay need not concentrate probability on already-dominant trajectory classes; it could re-seed or recombine them, supporting counter-mechanism (b) that sleep sampling is diversity-neutral or diversity-positive.
mapping.mapping_caveat: This is a qualitative review of rodent place-cell replay content; it does not quantify behavioural-diversity gain or loss, and reward-biasing of replay could equally CONCENTRATE behaviour on high-reward classes (an erosion pathway). It reframes the question rather than settling it.
mapping.source_context: Review of rodent hippocampal place-cell replay electrophysiology.

confidence_components.notes: Authoritative single-author review (Annu-Rev-adjacent). Low-moderate mapping fidelity: it changes the framing of Q-055 but offers no direct diversity metric. Included to keep the erosion premise itself under scrutiny.
